statement: Internal balances reseed: sum of per-farmer balances equals declared total and the farmers/balances arrays are equal length.
violation_consequence: No check that farmers.length==balances.length; mismatched arrays revert (DoS) or, if balances shorter and read defensively, silently truncate. Total guard exists but array-length guard does not.

statement: Migrated grown-stalk uses the correct stem delta and does not underflow when stem == stemTip.
formal_expression: accountStalk += uint96(stemTip - stem) * bdv with stemTip>=stem enforced
violation_consequence: stemTip>=stem is checked; but cast uint96(stemTip-stem) of an int96 difference could mis-handle large/negative-domain stems if stems are negative — needs verification that stem signage is bounded.

statement: Only the canonical L1 cross-domain messenger (with xDomainMessageSender == L1 Beanstalk) can trigger L2 Bean mints.
violation_consequence: If BRIDGE / L1BEANSTALK constants are wrong for the target L2, mints are either impossible (DoS) or, if mis-set, spoofable. Hardcoded addresses must match deployment.

statement: Chainlink TWAP loop must not underflow roundId or read across phase boundaries.
formal_expression: roundId-=1 only while a valid prior round exists in the same phaseId
violation_consequence: roundId is decremented by 1 across aggregator phases; Chainlink roundIds encode phaseId in the high bits, so naive -1 can cross into an invalid round, returning 0 (handled) or skewed TWAP.

statement: Total Bean supply minted on L2 during reseed equals the audited L1 Bean supply snapshot (no inflation).
formal_expression: bean.totalSupply() after ReseedBean == beanSupply param == L1 snapshot
violation_consequence: beanSupply, well bean amounts, and unripe supplies are all caller-supplied with no on-chain cross-check; an incorrect or malicious init param mints arbitrary Bean. Trust rests entirely on the upgrade caller.

statement: ReseedBarn fertilizer linked-list (fertFirst/nextFid/fertLast) is well-formed and ascending.
formal_expression: fertilizerIds strictly ascending; nextFid forms a single chain from fertFirst to fertLast
violation_consequence: No check enforces ascending order of fertilizerIds; a mis-ordered input corrupts the nextFid linked list used by Sun fertilizer payout iteration, mispaying or stranding fertilizer.

statement: L1 Beanstalk must be paused and liquidity moved to BCM before any L2 mint can occur (no double-spend across chains).
formal_expression: ReseedL2Migration.init sets paused=true before BeanL2MigrationFacet/burn flow
violation_consequence: If pause ordering or LP transfer fails (e.g. a token transfer returns false but is unchecked), liquidity may remain on L1 while L2 mints proceed, enabling cross-chain double-spend.

statement: Field pods/harvestable/harvested ordering holds: pods >= harvestable >= harvested.
violation_consequence: Checks exist, but only reachable if the loop (STATE-001) terminates; since the loop is broken, these guards are unreachable and field state is never finalized.

statement: Germinating stalk/roots transitions correctly across the 2-season germination window.
formal_expression: germinating deposits do not earn Bean/vote until fully germinated
violation_consequence: Migrated deposits set stalk directly via reseed; if germination state is not initialized consistently, freshly migrated stalk could vote/earn immediately or be double-counted.

statement: sunrise/season advancement is monotonic and cannot be triggered while paused.
violation_consequence: If pause flag interaction with migration leaves season state inconsistent post-reseed, first sunrise on L2 could mint based on stale deltaB.

statement: Flood (sop) distribution does not over-allocate Bean beyond the excess above peg.
formal_expression: sopBeans <= deltaB_excess; per-account share sums to total
violation_consequence: Rounding or share-accumulation error in flood could over-mint Bean to plenty holders, diluting peg.

statement: Dibbler sow: pods issued = beans sown * (1 + temperature/SCALE), with no rounding-up favoring the sower beyond soil.
formal_expression: pods == beans * (1+temp); soil decremented by beans
violation_consequence: Rounding in morning-auction temperature scaling could let a sower mint excess pods or sow beyond available soil.
If ownership transfer during reseed leaves owner unset/zero, an attacker could cut in a malicious facet and drain the diamond.
